labels.tower_res2: 价格/挂量双塔·残差压缩

source_initialization: Known Cross weights trained on16minute inputs are initialization only. Every train/eval window here has256frames; all modules are trained. No claim of starting from a256minute-trained source.
method: Full256frame encoders and Cross; trainable4160->256 channel projection; flatten16 consecutive channel vectors to4096 and learn4096->1024 for each of16matrix rows; inverse learned maps restore256frames. Full-window source temporal context precedes grouping. No16minute independent encoder calls or anchor resets.
initialization: Channel projection PCA fitted only on32complete256minute training windows; temporal projection starts as4DCT time modes per256channels. Both projections remain trainable; residual outputs start at zero.
comparison: Reference and shared groups share source weights; same-width compressed groups initially equal. Modality gates and two-source fusion alter tower initial outputs, which are reported separately.
precision: BF16 training with activation checkpointing; FP32 evaluation; both TF32 flags off
selection: All declared checkpoints and fixed512step endpoints on the same16development windows; seed42only;2026 is not used for fitting or selection.
